taxonomy.label: Extracellular matrix and tissue architecture
taxonomy.definition: Assembly, remodeling and structural roles of extracellular matrix and basement membrane proteins.
taxonomy.boundary_notes: Adhesion and intracellular cytoskeletal machinery belong to C08; circulating plasma proteins belong to C03 unless matrix assembly is the principal program.

taxonomy.label: Immunity and inflammation
taxonomy.definition: Innate and adaptive immune recognition, effector activity, complement, and inflammatory defense.
taxonomy.boundary_notes: Acute phase and complement programs belong here when defense is dominant; coagulation and transport dominated plasma modules belong to C03.

taxonomy.label: Hemostasis and circulating protein homeostasis
taxonomy.definition: Coagulation, fibrinolysis, protease inhibition and extracellular carrier functions of circulating proteins.
taxonomy.boundary_notes: Plasma origin is a composition hypothesis; the category describes protein functions. Immune effector and matrix dominated modules belong to C02 and C01 respectively.

taxonomy.label: Metabolism and energy production
taxonomy.definition: Mitochondrial respiration and substrate handling, carbohydrate, nucleotide and lipid metabolism, and energy generation.
taxonomy.boundary_notes: Mitochondrial translation is placed here only when coupled to a mitochondrial metabolic program; general translation and protein quality control belong to C05.

taxonomy.label: Protein synthesis and proteostasis
taxonomy.definition: Cytosolic translation, protein folding, modification, processing and degradation.
taxonomy.boundary_notes: RNA maturation and ribosome biogenesis belong to C06; mitochondrial metabolic maintenance belongs to C04 when energy and substrate functions dominate.

taxonomy.label: Gene expression and RNA processing
taxonomy.definition: Transcription, chromatin regulation, RNA processing, ribonucleoprotein assembly and ribosome biogenesis.
taxonomy.boundary_notes: Mature ribosomal translation belongs to C05; DNA replication and repair belong to C07.

taxonomy.label: DNA maintenance and cell proliferation
taxonomy.definition: DNA replication and repair, chromosome segregation, mitosis and cytokinesis.
taxonomy.boundary_notes: Chromatin regulation without a dominant replication, repair or division program belongs to C06.

taxonomy.label: Cytoskeleton, adhesion and contractility
taxonomy.definition: Actin and microtubule organization, cell adhesion, motility, and contractile machinery.
taxonomy.boundary_notes: Extracellular matrix assembly belongs to C01; neuron specific structural and synaptic programs belong to C11.

taxonomy.label: Membrane trafficking and secretion
taxonomy.definition: Endomembrane transport, vesicle dynamics, lysosomal handling, Golgi and ER trafficking, and secretion.
taxonomy.boundary_notes: Secreted proteins whose dominant roles are plasma homeostasis, immunity or matrix architecture belong to C03, C02 or C01.

taxonomy.label: Signaling and stress responses
taxonomy.definition: Receptor and intracellular signaling, redox regulation, stress adaptation and survival control.
taxonomy.boundary_notes: Redox catalysis embedded in a clear metabolic pathway belongs to C04; immune receptor signaling belongs to C02 when immune function dominates.

taxonomy.label: Neuronal structure and communication
taxonomy.definition: Neuronal differentiation, axonal and dendritic architecture, synaptic vesicle biology and neural communication.
taxonomy.boundary_notes: General cytoskeletal and vesicle programs lacking a coherent neuronal member group belong to C08 or C09.

taxonomy.label: Other
taxonomy.definition: Modules without a selected substantive functional category in this classification pass.
taxonomy.boundary_notes: A residual reporting category assigned to the 181 previously pending modules; it does not imply a shared biological mechanism.
